decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix lies outside the firm's announced industrial-technology direction, has little sunk or public commitment, and has not appeared on the website since 2019, so there is little to justify persisting.

The multi-model waste-to-energy extension line carries substantial sunk engineering effort and extends the core plant business, so management would likely blame its lower visibility on temporary market conditions and keep it.

As a publicly presented flagship with its own page and heavy invested engineering, the waste-oil-to-energy plant is central to the firm's announced direction, so weak results would be attributed to long industrial sales cycles and pandemic disruption.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is a declared flagship of the firm's sustainability mission, so the public commitment and the need to justify earlier decisions favor continuing despite uncertain results and less website presence.
